title: ArXiv Trending Physics — Weekly | 3–9 October 2026
global_caveat: arXiv publishes no official trending chart; this is an inferred selection based on concrete result strength, cross-subfield relevance, publication or collaboration signals, and measurement or hardware milestones. Citation and independent-attention evidence is limited for papers this recent.

sections.title: Observation of single top-quark production in the s-channel in proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s)=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
sections.abstract: ATLAS reports its first single-experiment observation of LHC s-channel single-top production using 140 fb^-1 of 13 TeV data and a graph-neural-network-assisted analysis.
sections.claimed_result: The observed significance is 5.1 sigma and the measured cross-section is 10.8 ± 1.5 (stat.) ± 1.6 (syst.) pb, consistent with the Standard Model.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; ATLAS proton-proton collision data, graph neural network, and likelihood fit
sections.unique_caveat: The result is from one experiment’s Run-2 dataset; the reported systematic uncertainty is 1.6 pb.

sections.title: Ringdown analysis of GW250114 with RingCWB
sections.abstract: The authors use RingCWB to measure the dominant ringdown mode and first overtone of GW250114 and test agreement with general relativity.
sections.claimed_result: The inferred dominant-mode frequency and damping-time deviations are consistent with zero within quoted 90% intervals.
sections.evidence_type: observational; LIGO gravitational-wave data reconstructed with coherent WaveBurst
sections.unique_caveat: No evidence is found for additional subdominant modes beyond the first overtone; the constraints depend on the ringdown model and reconstructed waveform.

sections.title: Error-Corrected Memory and Logic on a Heavy-Hex Superconducting-Qubit Processor
sections.abstract: The team demonstrates error-corrected memory and measurement-based logical operations on a 156-qubit superconducting processor using noise-informed decoding and component selection.
sections.claimed_result: Noise-aware strategies improve logical error probabilities by up to 35% for memory and 56% for measurement-based logic; post-selection raises reported Bell-state fidelity above 97%.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; dynamic compass-code memory, measurement-based logic, and lattice surgery
sections.unique_caveat: The largest quoted Bell fidelities rely on pre-selection and additional logical-gap post-selection.

sections.title: A solid-state nuclear clock based on VUV absorption spectroscopy of 229Th
sections.abstract: The authors demonstrate sustained operation of a thorium-229 nuclear clock in a calcium-fluoride crystal using vacuum-ultraviolet absorption.
sections.claimed_result: The reported fractional frequency instability reaches 1.24×10^-13 at 10^4 s.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; continuous-wave 148.4 nm absorption spectroscopy and a hydrogen-maser-referenced frequency comb
sections.unique_caveat: The headline figure is an instability measurement, not a claim of 10^-13 absolute clock accuracy; the continuous record spans 30 hours.

sections.title: Observation of the electromagnetic Dalitz transition J/psi to e+e- eta_c
sections.abstract: Using about 10.087 billion J/psi decays, BESIII reports the first observation of the electromagnetic Dalitz decay to e+e- eta_c and extracts form factors.
sections.claimed_result: The relative branching fraction is (0.65 ± 0.02 stat. ± 0.07 syst.)%; form factors show no significant deviation from theory.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; BESIII e+e- collision data at BEPCII
sections.unique_caveat: The quoted systematic uncertainty exceeds the statistical one.

sections.title: Wave-Growth-Limited Particle Confinement in a Near-Parallel Interplanetary Shock Observed by Parker Solar Probe
sections.abstract: Parker Solar Probe measurements constrain how self-generated Alfven waves limit proton energies near a near-parallel CME-driven shock.
sections.claimed_result: For the observed shock at 0.24 AU, the proton folding energy falls from about 6 to 1.5 MeV as the shock approaches.
sections.evidence_type: observational; Parker Solar Probe energetic-particle measurements during one interplanetary shock
sections.unique_caveat: The interpretation is based on one shock and a quasi-linear marginal-stability model.

sections.title: Undetected Photon Spectroscopy in the Long-wave and Far Infrared
sections.abstract: A nonlinear interferometer infers long-wave infrared sample spectra from a detected near-infrared signal, extending undetected-photon spectroscopy to 20 micrometres.
sections.claimed_result: The experiment demonstrates Kapton spectroscopy from 7.8 to 20 micrometres and SF6 detection near 10.55 micrometres.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; BaGa2GeSe6 nonlinear interferometer with silicon near-infrared detection
sections.unique_caveat: The abstract demonstrates selected laboratory samples and gas; broader analyte coverage is not established.

sections.title: Imaging ablator-fuel mix of hot spot in inertial confinement fusion via resonant X-ray absorption using an X-ray free electron laser
sections.abstract: The authors propose resonant X-ray absorption imaging with an XFEL to resolve dopant, ionization, opacity, and material-mix structure in ICF implosions, supported by a wire-target proof of principle and simulations.
sections.claimed_result: The diagnostic could provide space- and time-resolved constraints on ionization, opacity, and ablator-fuel mix in hot dense plasma.
sections.evidence_type: experimental and computational; coated-wire XFEL probing plus atomic and radiation-hydrodynamic simulations
sections.unique_caveat: An actual imploding ICF hot spot has not yet been imaged; that application is proposed.
